reason: I make $35k and the zoo, the park and library storytime are free, so $49 to $59 a month for somewhere to sit with my baby is a lot to ask. I would not pay when I already have places to go that cost nothing.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Up to age 5 is a big gap, and I would be paying for it.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap trial visit, plus a separate baby-only area or hours, so I could see it is safe for my baby before paying anything.
